sloka: राज्यम् च सुमहत् प्राप्य ताराम् च रुमया सह ।मित्रैः च सहितः तत्र वसामि विगत ज्वरः ॥४-४६-९॥
transliteration: rājyam ca sumahat prāpya tārām ca rumayā saha ।mitraiḥ ca sahitaḥ tatra vasāmi vigata jvaraḥ ॥4-46-9॥

translations.english: 'I lost hope of his life and came back to Kishkinda. Having got the kingdom, and also Ruma and Tara, I was anointed king and ruled it fearlessly with all friends.
